reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Generic overdispersed count model with Normal effects, simulations and a completely independent RNA reference arm.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult and verify primary Methods, supplements or validated tool protocols and transfer their settings to the selected dataset. Documenting settings or calling a method standard is not that action.

The generic count family, normalization, dispersion moderation and Normal-prior estimator remain unspecified, without a concrete lookup/calibration-to-executable choice procedure. The protocol correctly avoids inventing source facts but must still operationalize proposed choices.
Information cutpoints and calibration criteria are promised without a method to derive them, assess simulator/implementation accuracy or act on calibration failure.

checks.quote: lower-noise proxy, not as absolute truth
checks.reason: Reference uncertainty is acknowledged, but no propagation or selection-bias correction enters reference-based loss/attenuation; weak/unbounded estimates are not assigned an operational quantitative handling rule.
Biological replication is recognized, but a justified meaningful-effect/precision or power calculation and simulation Monte Carlo precision/stopping rule are absent.
No operational randomized/balanced processing or masked QC/estimator-comparison plan, nor justified equivalent bias control, is specified.
Eligibility intent is present but failed-fit/missing-measurement handling, all-eligible denominators and stopping/maximal acquisition rules remain unspecified.
No executable primary method-difference uncertainty procedure and relevant multiplicity/error-control rule is fixed; listing metrics or interval outputs is insufficient.
Sensitivity scenarios are named, but bounded settings or a concrete derivation-and-lock procedure for the essential prior/filter/model choices are absent.
Possible failure modes are named without a diagnostic result linked to an ordered technical repair and retest.
No operational iteration policy identifies what stays frozen, what may change and the fresh independent confirmation required after a change.

checks.quote: quantification procedure and version once chosen
checks.reason: Input checksum/sample provenance is useful, but exact command/environment/code/output-table mapping and an immutable executable audit package are missing.
Figure concepts do not supply numeric source tables plus a clean-environment rerun, numerical tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit.

historical_match_reason: Question, regularization tradeoff and proposed stratified readouts align. The primary method retains Normal shrinkage, and heavier tails are a distinct future proposal rather than an adaptive intervention. The prediction is Normal-versus-unshrunk performance, not the historical heavy-tail improvement. No qualified hit.
